scope: Read-only source review of frozen author delivery. No modules evaluated, tests/builds/actions run, or candidate changes made. Findings require root execution.

findings.issue: Linux live wrapper calls h.assertLive and h.failed, but not the durable-state check that detects lost/replaced state file or missing marker. The primitive invokes that continuity check through h.state/check, while assertLive only checks owner lifetime/lock. Cached records/get/final assertLive can therefore miss state loss while lock remains.
findings.suggestedRegression: External final gate removes established state or marker after sending intent was persisted. Require zero wallet calls and latched reads; also check records/get after removal.

findings.issue: Sponsored final gate precedes durableStep for authorization, lease signature and POST. No permission+owner recheck after persistence at actual side-effect call. Returned typed signature likewise persists after permission check and returns without another boundary check.
findings.suggestedRegression: Revoke gate during externally injected persistence, using real shipped client with inert signer/HTTP. Require no next signature/POST, truthful retained classification and restart hold.

findings.issue: Shared physical store does not itself coordinate cross-kind unknown nonce obligations: sponsored admission filters only sponsored records for this deployment; direct durableBlock filters only write records. Author explicitly leaves EIP7702 authorization/direct nonce interaction unhandled.
findings.suggestedRegression: Unknown direct write then sponsored authorization, and unknown sponsored POST/auth then direct send, across restart. Require exact operator-domain nonce fencing; do not treat serial in-process queue as durable reconciliation.
